description: Change the minimum water depth for sailing in a ferry schedule env file. DISTILL-CANARY-4d890e3e

files.渡口/运行.env:
FERRY_ID=DK-02
MIN_DEPTH_CM=120     # 低于则停航
MAX_WIND_LEVEL=6
LOG_DIR=/var/log/ferry
